earnings.title: SS&C Technologies Releases Q3 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Q3 2026 GAAP revenue $1,690.0 million, up 7.8%, Fully Diluted GAAP Earnings Per Share $0.83
Adjusted revenue $1,691.1 million, up 7.8%, Adjusted Diluted Earnings Per Share $1.78, up 14.8%
GAAP operating income margin for Q3 2026 was 24.2 percent and GAAP net income of $198.9 million for Q3 2026.
Q3 2026 GAAP Revenue growth and Adjusted Revenue growth were 7.8 percent.
Q3 2026 Adjusted Organic Revenue Growth was 5.2 percent.

quotes.text: SS&C delivered another quarter of strong results, with Q3 organic revenue growth of 5.2%, record adjusted consolidated EBITDA of $674.8 million, and margins of 39.9%, keeping us on track to achieve our full-year goals.
quotes.by: Bill Stone, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

items.heading: Our business is greatly affected by changes in the state of the general economy and the financial markets, and uncertainty in the general economy, the financial services industry or other industries in which our clients operate could disproportionately affect the demand for our products and services.
We may not achieve the anticipated benefits from our acquisitions and may face difficulties in integrating them.
Consolidations or failures among our clients or within their respective industries could adversely affect us by causing declines in demand for our products and services.
We are subject to the variations and fluctuations of the asset management industry.
If we are unable to retain and attract clients, our revenues and net income would remain stagnant or decline.
If we cannot attract, train and retain qualified employees, we may not be able to provide adequate technical expertise and customer service to our clients.
